spectralPower_natCast.signature:
{n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (r : ℕ) :
    spectralPower A (r : ℝ) = A ^ r

modulus_power_eight.signature:
{n : ℕ} (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    matrixModulus X = CFC.sqrt (X.conjTranspose * X) ∧
    (matrixModulus X).PosSemidef ∧
    spectralPower (matrixModulus X) 8 = (X.conjTranspose * X) ^ (4 : ℕ)

comparison_positive_real.signature:
{n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hBinv : IsUnit B)
    (k p : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    (leftDet A B k p).im = 0 ∧ 0 < (leftDet A B k p).re ∧
    (rightDet A B k p).im = 0 ∧ 0 < (rightDet A B k p).re
